newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka slips on Latvian stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka slips on Latvian stock exchange.

text.p: Shares in key bank Unibanka and leading secondary market share Kaija took a tumble on Tuesday as overall market volume was buoyant, the Riga stock exchange said.
Unibanka dipped to 2.02 lats from 2.05 lats on turnover of 26,045 lats out of total market volume of 80,914 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet, also on the official list, was stable at one lat on trade of 9,914 lats.
On the secondary list, fish cannery Kaija slipped to 1.10 lats from 1.20 on activity of 5,710 lats.
But the most active share of the day was the Daugavpils machine chain factory at a high 29,670 lats of trade.
It put in a healthy rise, gaining to 92 santimes from 85.
Other shares on the secondary list were more muted with the Riga yeast factory trading 1,542 lats and rising to 1.55 lats from 1.50 lats.
The Riga agricultural machine factory dipped one santime to 11 on turnover of 1,225 lats and the Mangali Shipyard gained to 35 santimes from 31 on activity of 1,152 lats.
